name: bard
lore:
The Bard is a creature of resonance, found wherever the pulse of life beats strongest—from the velvet shadows of royal courts to the salt-cracked air of dockside taverns. They are the world’s living archives, feeding on the echoes of history and the raw friction of emotion. Behaviorally, they are social chameleons, weaving themselves into the tapestry of any culture they encounter.

While others wield steel or cold arcana, the Bard manipulates the fundamental vibrations of the Weave through verse, song, or terrifying silence. They do not merely observe history; they shape its legacy. Beware their charm, for a Bard’s tongue is a dual-edged blade: one side crafts a hero’s immortality, while the other carves a kingdom’s ruin. To travel with one is to ensure your deeds endure, provided you can survive the scrutiny of their song.
